title: Splitnir the Primal

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Splitnir the Primal is the upgraded form of Splitnir using the Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, they gain 10 poison damage and their hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Immobilized.
Upgrading a Splitnir to Splitnir the Primal will always result in a quality 1 weapon, regardless of the original weapon's quality.

Upgrading a Splitnir to Splitnir the Primal will always result in a quality 1 weapon, regardless of the original weapon's quality.
